picks.question: Will the unemployment rate (U-3) be above 4.1% in October?
picks.why: A rising jobless rate would signal labor-market cooling, shaping Fed rate decisions and the odds of a broader slowdown.

picks.question: Will inflation reach more than 4.5% in 2026?
picks.why: Inflation above 4.5% would test the Fed's credibility and squeeze real wages, with consequences for rates, bonds, and household budgets.

picks.question: Strait of Hormuz traffic returns to normal by December 31?
picks.why: Roughly a fifth of global oil passes through Hormuz, so prolonged disruption keeps energy prices, shipping costs, and inflation risks elevated.

picks.question: Billionaire one-time wealth tax passes in California election 2026?
picks.why: A state-level wealth tax would be a major real-world test of taxing wealth directly, including revenue yield and capital flight.

picks.question: Will Anthropic have the best AI model at the end of December 2026?
picks.why: Leadership in frontier AI is shifting quickly, with implications for where investment, talent, and productivity gains concentrate.

picks.question: Will OpenAI announce another Millennium Prize solution by December 31, 2027?
picks.why: AI solving a famous open math problem would mark a leap in machine reasoning, with broad implications for research productivity.
